summary.text: Rachael Cabral-Guevara is a Republican member of the Wisconsin State Senate who has represented District 19 since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026, general election.
A family nurse practitioner and business owner, she previously served in the State Assembly from 2021 to 2023.

paragraphs.text: Rachael Cabral-Guevara was born in Appleton, Wisconsin, and lives in Fox Crossing.

She earned a B.S. in biology and chemistry from Mount Mary College in 2000, a B.S. in nursing from the University of Wisconsin at Oshkosh in 2004, and a master's degree in nursing from the University of Wisconsin at Milwaukee in 2008.
Her career experience includes working as a family nurse practitioner and owning Nurse Practitioner Health Services and Your Clinic Now.
Cabral-Guevara represented Assembly District 55 from 2021 to 2023 and assumed office in the Senate on January 3, 2023, succeeding Roger Roth.

In the 2025-2026 session she chairs the Senate Health Committee, is vice-chair of the Universities and Technical Colleges Committee, and serves on the Agriculture and Revenue, Mental Health, Substance Abuse Prevention, Children and Families, and Joint Legislative Council committees.
